description: Return the stored image (JPEG) of one graphics page - an organigram, chart or diagram that Matrix keeps as a picture next to the document text - together with document name, page number and size. Use the `page_image_id` of a search hit (a chunk marked found_via_page_image) to look at the page that made it relevant, e.g. to read a figure the extracted text does not contain. Unknown id = error.

page_image_id.description: The page_image_id from a search_context / get_chunks hit.

name: get_page_image
